item.description:
Aside 2.0.3

a round of fixes for recording, notes, dictation and aside cloud, found in a code review of the whole app.

recording

  • stopping right after you pressed record now really stops: the microphone no longer stays open when the stop landed while the mic was still starting.
  • a recording that starts after your call audio broke no longer begins with a piece of the previous call.
  • a meeting you paused right after starting is offered for recovery again instead of being cleaned away.
  • with airpods or another bluetooth headset connected, aside no longer tries the microphone over and over before a meeting; that retrying used to switch the headset into its low-quality call mode and make it crackle.

transcript

  • the live transcript no longer loses half a sentence each time it rolls to a new window, and never says a sentence twice.
  • "no, no, no, don't cancel" stays in the transcript; the filter for stuck repetitions now only removes real loops.
  • in a meeting recorded through one microphone with several people in the room, nobody is guessed to be "you" any more.
  • a one-word answer of yours between the other side's words stays yours when there was a pause around it.
  • a recovered meeting is read in its own language, not the previous meeting's.
  • the sharper speech model is picked up when the current meeting ends, not only after a restart.
  • an identifier like customer_id_status in a note stays exactly as written; underscores only mean italics at word edges.

notes

  • the notes you typed under "your notes" survive when the summary is written again.
  • a title you renamed while the summary was still on its way stays renamed.
  • a summary that arrives late shows up in the library without reopening the note.
  • the library follows a new notes folder the moment you pick it.
  • a meeting without speaker labels now shows its transcript, and "try again" works for it.
  • recordings that belong to another notes folder are no longer cleaned away after you switch folders.
  • a note with an umlaut in its name is committed like any other.
  • a short description you rewrote while the summary was still on its way stays yours.
  • a question you ask in the library after a meeting is answered from your notes, not from the meeting that just ended.

dictation

  • the free week starts when you finish the setup, not when you open the settings.
  • a take that was still being written when the mac went to sleep is no longer typed into whatever is in front when it wakes.
  • letting go of the key and pressing it again right away starts a new take instead of discarding it.
  • a hands-free take you walked away from keeps its words for you to copy.
  • the setup says so when the dictation key could not be armed, instead of calling itself done.

aside cloud

  • a summary that broke off halfway is no longer saved as if it were complete; the note keeps "try again".
  • when your keychain refuses to store the access, aside says so instead of running into a rate limit.
  • a meeting counted during a keychain hiccup is not counted a second time on the next launch.
  • with your own api key, an answer that broke off halfway is no longer saved as complete.

settings

  • picking a notes folder inside documents, desktop or icloud drive now warns you first: those folders are synced, and the sync can truncate a note while aside is still writing it.

agents

  • the vault search no longer follows links that point outside your notes folder.
  • an agent that hung up no longer keeps its slot until the timeout.
